title: Mod Numero
script:
--==================================================
-- ? № ?
-- FLY V2 - PC + MOBILE
-- DEXTER HUB INTEGRADO
-- LOGO COM EMOJI 🌃
-- BOTAO JERK OFF (R6) ADICIONADO
--==================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- LIMPAR VERSAO ANTERIOR
pcall(function()
    local old = game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("? № ?")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
end)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "? № ?"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local FLY_SPEED = 60

-- TOGGLE 🌃
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Parent = gui
toggle.Name = "? № ? Toggle"
toggle.Text = "🌃"
toggle.TextSize = 42
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 85)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.7, 0)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.Active = true
toggle.Draggable = true
toggle.AutoButtonColor = false

Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

-- MENU
local menu = Instance.new("Frame")
menu.Parent = gui
menu.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 380)
menu.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 0, 20)
menu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
menu.Visible = false
menu.Active = true
menu.Draggable = true

Instance.new("UICorner", menu).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- TITULO
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Parent = menu
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
title.Text = "? № ?"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextSize = 18

-- SCROLL
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Parent = menu
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -55)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 55)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 700)

-- VARIAVEIS
local flying = false
local infJump = false
local noclip = false

local bv, bg
local flyConnection
local flyButton
local y = 5

-- BOTAO ON/OFF
local function criarBotao(nome, funcao)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = scroll
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, y)
    btn.Text = nome .. ": OFF"
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 1

    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    y = y + 45
    local estado = false

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        estado = not estado
        btn.Text = nome .. ": " .. (estado and "ON" or "OFF")
        funcao(estado, btn)
    end)

    return btn
end

-- BOTAO DE ACAO
local function criarBotaoAcao(nome, funcao)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = scroll
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, y)
    btn.Text = nome
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 1

    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    y = y + 45

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        funcao(btn)
    end)

    return btn
end

-- PARAR FLY
local function stopFly()
    flying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if bv then
        bv:Destroy()
        bv = nil
    end

    if bg then
        bg:Destroy()
        bg = nil
    end

    if flyButton then
        flyButton.Text = "FLY: OFF"
    end
end

-- FLY V2 - PC + MOBILE
local function Fly(estado)
    if not estado then
        stopFly()
        return
    end

    if flying then return end

    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    flying = true

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "?№?FlyVelocity"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = root

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name = "?№?FlyGyro"
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bg.P = 9000
    bg.D = 500
    bg.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
    bg.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying then return end

        if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        local direction = Vector3.zero
        local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)

        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        end

        if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatRight = flatRight.Unit
        end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            local forwardAmount = move:Dot(flatLook)
            local rightAmount = move:Dot(flatRight)
            direction = look * forwardAmount + flatRight * rightAmount
        end

        if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then direction += look end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then direction -= look end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then direction -= right end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then direction += right end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then direction += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then direction -= Vector3.yAxis end
        end

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            direction = direction.Unit * FLY_SPEED
        end

        bv.Velocity = direction
        bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)

    if flyButton then
        flyButton.Text = "FLY: ON"
    end
end

-- SYSTEM BROKEN
local function SystemBroken()
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(
            "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Ragdoll-Engine-BEST-SCRIPT-WORKING-SystemBroken-7544"
        ))()
    end)

    if not success then
        warn("? № ? - System Broken: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

-- NOCLIP
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if noclip and LP.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LP.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- INFINITY JUMP
UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJump and LP.Character then
        local hum = LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

-- FUNCOES PRINCIPAIS
flyButton = criarBotao("FLY", Fly)

criarBotao("SPEED", function(estado)
    local hum = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = estado and 100 or 16
    end
end)

criarBotao("JUMP POWER", function(estado)
    local hum = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.JumpPower = estado and 150 or 50
    end
end)

criarBotao("INFINITY JUMP", function(estado)
    infJump = estado
end)

criarBotao("WALL HACK", function(estado)
    noclip = estado
end)

-- TP TOOL
criarBotaoAcao("TP TOOL", function()
    local backpack = LP:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    local mouse = LP:GetMouse()

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "TP Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false
    tool.CanBeDropped = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local character = LP.Character
        local hit = mouse.Hit

        if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            character:MoveTo(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end)

-- SYSTEM BROKEN
criarBotaoAcao("SYSTEM BROKEN", function()
    SystemBroken()
end)

-- DEXTER HUB - ANIMACOES R6
criarBotaoAcao("DEXTER HUB", function()
    local sucesso, erro = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(
            "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Fe-r6-animations-I-found-random-tho-47049"
        ))()
    end)

    if not sucesso then
        warn("? № ? - Erro no Dexter Hub: " .. tostring(erro))
    end
end)

-- SHIFT~LOCK
criarBotaoAcao("shift~lock", function()
    local sucesso, erro = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(
            "https://scriptblox.com/raw/Universal-Script-Maxus-Shiftlock-55223"
        ))()
    end)

    if not sucesso then
        warn("? № ? - Erro no shift~lock: " .. tostring(erro))
    end
end)

-- JERK OFF (R6) - BOTAO ADICIONADO
-- Este botão não executa o carregador sexual do link.
criarBotaoAcao("jerk off (R6)", function(btn)
  
    warn("? № ? - Animação R6 não configurada.")
end)

-- ABRIR / FECHAR MENU
toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
end)

-- MORTE / RENASCIMENTO
local function onCharacterAdded(character)
    stopFly()

    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        stopFly()
    end)
end

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if LP.Character then
    onCharacterAdded(LP.Character)
end

print("? № ? com FLY V2, DEXTER HUB e novo botao carregado!")
